description:
Cast Cartouche of Solidarity by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Cartouche of Solidarity enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Cartouche of Solidarity attached to it, adding {W}.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Cartouche of Solidarity from your graveyard with the ability to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Cast Cartouche of Solidarity by paying {W}, attaching it to the Warrior made in step 2.
Repeat from step 2.
